notes.title: Forsaken Isle 1.0 Release
notes.notes: [p]After many years of updates, content additions, changes, bug fixes, and community requested changes (thanks for the feedback!), and a few hiccups along the way. [b]Forsaken isle is now officially out of early access![/b] [/p][p][/p][h2][b]New Zones[/b][/h2][p]This update adds a new fiery zone to the initial island, with unique biomes, creatures, and bosses.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7803178/539d98419353a3b6b393d092bf5688f16c126467.png"][/img][/p][p]A new void themed biome which spreads over time. notes.title: Update 0.12.7
notes.notes:
This update brings some quality of life and improvements to crafting, and item collection and recipe menus.

[h3]Patch Notes[/h3]

[list]
[*] Added a search bar for items and recipes in the codex
[*] All undiscovered items and recipes in the codex now show as hidden to better track progress
[*] Added completion rates to the item and recipe tabs in the codex
[*] Added items categories to the crafting menu  
[*] Furnace screens now display stats for accepted fuel items
[*] Crafting screens now display all nearby workbenches
[*] Added a crafting screen toggle to display partial recipes(on by default)
[*] Added additional sorting options for inventories(A-Z, rarity, type)
[*] Creatures no longer have increased nigh time aggression for the first night
[*] Difficulty now affects maximum creature spawns and aggression
[*] Tiles can now be placed under existing tiles
[*] Crafting recipes now correctly update after crafting an item
[*] Fixed an issue with some codex recipes not correctly updating
[*] Deep hole tiles now correctly render tile transitions
[*] Fixed an issue with some broken text outlines
[*] Items can now be placed on crafted dungeon brick floors
[*] Crystallized wall incorrectly placed the wrong wall
[*] Reduced the attack range and health of spectral bows in the dungeon 
[/list]


[h3]June/July content update[/h3]
Development on update 1.0 is still underway and should (hopefully) be ready around late June! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7803178/6456be86a12554d6036a62b776c36c9246892397.png[/img]
[i]New 1.0 obsidian fortress biome[/i]

notes.title: Update 0.12.6
notes.notes:
This update brings new biomes, revamps to some existing biomes, as well as some minor map generation tweaks for underground layers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7803178/aedf1562575bb58c368b03b7c77ad41b5d728943.png[/img]
[i]Revamped spider biome[/i]

[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]

[h3]Items[/h3]
[list]
[*] 40+ new items
[*] New type of item able to summon specific creatures
[*] Now able to capture and move animals using a creature cage(pigs, sheep, chicken, piglet, lamb, chick)
[*] New armour stand item
[*] New bridge item. Can be placed over deep holes 
[*] New tier of magic gem, emerald. Found in deeper caves
[*] Added additional ways to acquire Boots
[*] Added a player notification if equipped tool isn't powerful enough
[*] Weapon tooltips display the weapon type and any unique properties
[/list]
[h3]Biomes and Maps[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added a biome colour overlay to the map screen
[*] Added beach and ocean biomes to the initial island (save files will be roughly converted to include these biomes, in preparation for a future update)
[*] Improved map generation for dirt and stone caves. Now generates chasms and rivers
[*] 2 entirely new biomes. These will only be generated on new worlds
[*] New Goblin Town biome containing unique enemies and items. Can be found in dirt caves
[*] New Crystal Cave biome containing unique enemies and items. Can be found in stone caves
[*] Increased the amount of Mine biomes
[*] A new enemy added to the Mine biome
[*] Increased the amount of Spider Lair biomes 
[*] Updated the art for the Spider Lair biome
[*] Slightly reduced spider aggression 
[*] New items added to the Spider Lair biome
[*] Changed the behaviour of some spider enemies
[*] Biomes now have unique population limits
[*] Red treasure goblins can be found on the deepest cave level
[*] Updated some overworld sprites
[*] New mossy ruins can now contain a teleport to the boss arena
[*] Added new items to the Blue Mushroom biome
[*] Enemies have higher aggression during night time on the overworld
[/list]
[h3]Changes and Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Turtles no longer despawn
[*] Reapers Scythe now only harms hostile targets
[*] Shrines no longer have collision
[*] Items on the cursor are now properly removed when used
[*] Small palm trees no longer alter the floor when destroyed
[*] Balanced the sell value of certain items
[*] Light is now properly calculated when placing or removing tiles
[*] Deep hole tiles now render correctly
[*] Particles from torches now spawn in the correct place
[*] Boomerangs now use the weapons attack rate when thrown at close range
[*] Increased the maximum amount of recipes displayed on the unlock toast
[*] Recipe unlocks now display the keybind to view the recipe tab in the codex
[*] Codex now defaults to the recipe tab
[*] Fixed some accessory slots not being calculated for certain stats
[*] Fixed an issue with beam weapons and enemies turning invisible
[*] Certain floors now require a shovel to remove, to prevent accidental floor destruction
[*] The Witch Doctors house can now be destroyed
[*] The stairs leading to the lower level of the ship should now be functional again
[*] Added higher resolution monitor options up to 3480x2160
[*] Polished main menu art and animations. Fixed art scaling on higher resolutions
[*] Fixed the crate destruction sound playing occasionally
[/list]

[h3]Known Issues:[/h3]
Travelling to a new island will sometimes cause the air travel button to not function. This can be fixed by sailing to another island and returning, or reloading the save


[h3][b]Future Plans[/b][/h3]
I've also been working on newer content in preparation for 1.0, which should be the next major content patch, along with some crafting quality of life changes, in game item sources, search bars, etc. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7803178/09b8575d61d840eae6ffc60955e504613330f8a3.png[/img]
[i]1.0 sneak peek [/i]

notes.title: Update 0.12.5
notes.notes:
This update is mainly focused on improvements, bug fixes, and community requested features.

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]

[list]
[*] Added a captain's quarter level to the ship with an interactable world map(works with existing saves)
[*] Updated the ship deck and hull level art
[*] Food and potion items will now add to the remaining timer if that buff is already active
[*] Normal damage no longer harms animals(weapon and accessories will note when animal damage is enabled)
[*] Adjusted animal hitboxes to match their sprites
[*] Farm animals now check for closest trough
[*] Gave sheep and lambs a makeover
[*] Fixed a performance issue related to entity pathfinding(still investigating the frame drops when switching levels, but this may help)
[*] The Travelling Merchant now properly despawns at night
[*] Dodge and damage reduction are now capped at 75%
[*] Creatures are now correctly moved to closest tile when stuck
[*] Escape rope now correctly checks for legit tiles when used
[*] Increased ward totem size to match the tooltip value
[*] Tall jungle palm leaves can now be destroyed
[*] Mouse clicks are no longer registered when the game window is out of focus
[*] Polished item tooltips
[*] Removed outdated keybinds
[*] Improved readability of event toasts
[*] Improved readability of the artifact unlock text
[*] Artifact unlock screens now display the "view artifact collection" hotkey
[/list]

notes.notes:
Slightly reduced the aggro range of enemies
Added missing loot tables

notes.title: Update 0.12
notes.notes:
The latest 0.12 update adds a new island to explore, with unique biomes, enemies, and items.

[h2]Full notes[/h2]

[list]
[*] New island! The wizard tower can be accessed after defeating the tundra boss
[*] New unique biomes, each with their own enemies, items, and artifacts
[*] New NPC with their own item collection and rewards
[*] New mini boss
[*] Added a new warding totem item. These will prevent enemies from spawning in a certain radius when placed. Can currently be bought from the witch doctor, found in the starting island swamp biome


[*] Improved performance when rendering a large amount of hole tiles
[*] Reduced the frequency of crashes caused by alt tabbing
[*] Fixed some tile transitions using incorrect sprites
[*] Jumping enemies such as slimes can no longer jump over taller walls
[*] Monster aggro range is now different depending on the biome. (Early game biomes should feel more peaceful)
[*] Updated some old artwork
[*] Fixed tile sprites jumping by a single pixel when rendered at the top edge of the screen
[*] Fixed an issue with ghost items remaining after crafting from nearby inventories. This should also fix the issue with stacks being deleted after depositing into chests
[*] Slightly reduced the number of max enemies present in the dungeon biome
[*] Fixed an issue with the campfire no longer providing its buff after switching levels
[*] Fixed an issue with some tiles blocking light
[*] Light will no properly calculate when placing a tile 
[*] Entities will now load in their correct positions
[*] Creatures that get trapped in a solid tile will now be moved to a nearby free tile
[/list]

[h3]Current issues and plans[/h3]

The red teleporter pad found in the new area, is the end of the current chapter and will be added in the next update!
Level lighting is sometimes incorrectly calculated when loading a save file. This can be fixed by removing or placing a tile that affects light, such as a torch or solid tile

notes.title: Forsaken Isle Update 0.11
notes.notes:

[*] [b]Added a quick stack to nearby chests[/b]
[*] Added new boss to the Tundra(can be summoned in the yeti lair, using a special item)
[*] Added a new mini surface biome to Tundra
[*] Added boss music
[*] Added new items 
[/list]

[list]

[list]

notes.title: 0.10.4 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
It wasn't too clear on how to progress in the game, from the hidden ladders, to the golem boss arena, to finding the imprisoned npc in the dungeon. I've made improvements to these areas to hopefully make the whole thing a little more intuitive. I've also made a lot of changes to how save files work behind the scenes. Files should become corrupt a lot less often, as well as keeping a backup save from the last stable save state. A bunch of QoL and fixes are also included.

[h2][b]Patch Notes v0.10.4[/b][/h2]

[h3]Added[/h3]
[list]
[*] Replaced hidden ladders in caves with locked trapdoors. These require copper and iron keys to open(new world only)
[*] Added new shrines that are generated randomly throughout the world. These provide unique buffs and +recharge over time(new world only)
[*] Added sort buttons to inventory screen and containers
[*] Added map markers for NPCs and bosses
[/list]
[h3]Changes and Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*]Corrupt or missing save files will be marked on the world select screen
[*]Corrupt saves will attempt to load the previous save state(requires post-patch save)
[*]Hostile creatures will no longer spawn on most crafted floor tiles
[*]Ship level light and colour is now related to the time of day
[*]Map screen zoom level will now be saved when closing the map
[*]Furnace no longer burns new fuel while idle
[*]Adjusted loottables for breakable boxes found underground and in dungeons 
[*]Ammo looted from the world will now automatically stack in the ammo bag
[*]Artifact descriptions are no longer cut off on the artifact screen
[*]Cooking and alchemy ingredients are now counted while on the hotbar
[*]Adjusted the health of most creatures found in tundra
[*]Chests spawned in the world are no longer hidden behind larger tiles
[*]Loading screen now uses the updated menu art
[*]Existing hidden ladders now have a different sprite
[/list]
[h3]Fixed[/h3]
[list]
[*] Saves are much less likely to corrupt when closing the game, or from crashing
[*] Fixed a crash caused by autosaving while travelling to an island
[*] Fixed a crash on the world select screen caused by a corrupt save file
[*] Deathcap mushrooms will now regrow in caves
[*] Autosave selected setting was not being applied on game launch
[*] Passive creatures will now slowly spawn over time
[*] Item collection screens now display items on multiple rows
[*] Inventory close button is now aligned correctly for all resolutions
[/list]

[b]Whats Next?[/b]
I'll continue to work on bug fixes and QoL features such as, using items directly from the inventory or mouse, preventing the craft recipes from shuffling around mid craft, placing floor tiles under walls.
I'm also currently working on the next bosses(the dungeon and tundra), as well as a new small side island to explore.

notes.title: Update 0.9.7 and the future
notes.notes:
A new festive holiday themed update just went live, including a winter themed art overhaul, a new boss, holiday merchants and more!

[h1]Patch notes[/h1]

[b]Seasonal event[/b]
[list]
    [*]Winter themed sprites
    [*]A new early game boss
    [*]Mobs now have a chance to drop presents, containing a bunch of new seasonal items
    [*]New weather type - snow
    [*]Santa NPC
[/list]
[b]Features[/b]
[list]
    [*]Travelling merchants now have a chance to arrive, selling a variety of new items
    [*]Informational items
    [*]Improved discovery system
    [*]Health pickup items
    [*]NPC shops
    [*]Currency
    [*]Pots can be found littered through-out the world, containg coins and items
    [*]Weather systems
[/list]
[b]Bug fixes[/b]
[list]
    [*]Arced projectiles, such as bombs, now properly cause damage on impact
    [*]Projectiles and particles lifetime base on real time, no longer locked to fps
    [*]Fixed a crash caused by hitting "1" while not in an inventory screen
    [*]Fixed projectiles not correctly displaying particle effects
[/list]




[b]The future[/b]

While I don't have an official roadmap (yet), I took some time to fully plan out the game, and what needs to change to consider full release, so I'll give a brief run down on what to expect.

NPCs/followers. While the first set of NPCs are in game (merchants), they currently have no permanent residence. Future followers will require housing before they move in, and unlocked via certain requirements.

Home ship. This will serve as a central hub containing the world map (see below), and crew members will hang around there until moved into a home.

World map. Will contain increasingly difficult islands and areas to explore, which will also be unlocked via a number of ways, such as, special followers, defeating bosses, and completing quests for townsfolk.

Pets. 

More in depth weather systems. While currently purely visual, weathers system will impact gameplay in some way, whether it be watering/destroying crops (rain/snow), effecting line of sight(sandstorm), harmful sailing(lightning storms), and so on.


The current plan is to have all of the above implemented within the next year (hopefully sooner), including more frequent updates/dev blog updates on what's being worked on.


Smoodlez
